limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter advancing on idle cycles, but it also made ready_a high during reset and allowed the first post-reset edge to accept a bit that the original logic would not accept.
The rewrite asserted valid_b only when the sixth bit was accepted, whereas the reference preserves assertion whenever the pre-edge count is five, including cycles stalled before the sixth bit.
The passing testbench encoded the rewrite's assumptions that ready_a is high in reset and valid_b pulses only on the sixth accepted bit, so its reset and stall cases could not expose either mismatch.
